scope: Twenty individually reviewed official viewing links. Exact institutions, primary designation and selected recorded business confirmed; current live/all rooms/audio/accessibility/reuse remain scoped and unresolved. This is not an HTTP-only or full-service certification.

results.note: Scoped publication review: Official assembly webcasts designate Public Accounts recordings for 1 and 2 October 2026. Both decode in Chromium and WebKit. The first 1 October sample shows a listener; a later 3600-second sample confirms a participant speaking at a lit committee microphone. The 2 October sample shows a separate participant speaking. Original, English and French interpretation selectors are present; only default playback was tested, muted. Plenary and current live coverage remain unverified.

Scoped publication review: The parliament live page explicitly designates its YouTube plenary archive. Distinct 28 and 30 September 2026 recordings decode in Chromium and WebKit; selected frames show different speakers at the parliamentary lectern with crest and lit microphone. Parliamentary rules establish legislative and budgetary powers within autonomy and Swedish as the working language. This validates selected archived plenaries, not all sessions, live or committees.

Scoped publication review: The parliament website designates its official recording channel, corroborated by the exact institution item and provider ID. Dates are the official titles. This is selected archived proceedings validation; current live, every room and audible language variants remain unverified.
